subject.title: Control UI: Config upgrade/hardening suggestions should apply changes automatically with before/after diff and user acceptance, not direct users to edit files manually

question: Which Control UI config and security recommendations may mutate user config, and what confirmation, audit, restart, and dismissal policy must gate those mutations?
rationale: The implementation would give the browser UI authority to alter auth-related configuration, so automation should not choose the security boundary or product policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Allowlisted Recommendation Actions
options.body: Approve a narrow reusable UI pattern for vetted config recommendations that routes through existing config validation and requires explicit before/after diff acceptance before applying.

options.title: Keep Recommendations Read-Only
options.body: Leave Control UI hardening guidance as text and docs only, avoiding UI-originated config mutation for auth/security settings.

options.title: Defer Fixes To Doctor
options.body: Make doctor or upgrade-scan the canonical fixer and have Control UI link users to that flow rather than applying patches itself.

recommendation.title: Allowlisted Recommendation Actions
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow reusable UI pattern for vetted config recommendations that routes through existing config validation and requires explicit before/after diff acceptance before applying.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest observed recent history across the login recovery, Config/Settings UX, and security-sensitive Control UI boundary involved here.
